topic: No big companies on campus? Find your internship off-campus in 1st/2nd year

cover.concept: Surreal landscape: a tiny student walks out of a lone open campus gate into vast rolling hills dotted with small lit buildings far away.
cover.lineDraft: Your first internship won't come to campus.

slides.label: The truth
slides.idea: The internship you want won't visit your campus; you go to it

slides.label: Step 1
slides.idea: Build one project with a live link before you apply

slides.label: Step 2
slides.idea: Find the doors: company career pages and student programmes (verify names and dates on the day)

slides.label: Step 3
slides.idea: Write short, specific messages to engineers about their work

slides.label: Every week
slides.idea: Every week: five applications, two messages, one project update

slides.label: Step 4
slides.idea: Track every application and follow up once after a week
friend who says "my college has no placements"

images.name: cover
images.prompt: Photoreal surreal landscape photograph, magazine-ad quality, warm golden-hour light, subtle film grain. A lone, open wrought-iron college gate stands by itself in a vast green meadow; one tiny figure seen from behind walks away from it toward rolling hills where many small buildings glow on the far horizon under huge soft clouds. The top 35% of the frame is open sky. Portrait 2:3, natural colours. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.
